name: Penetrator
description: The Penetrator was a Star Destroyer under construction at Kuat Drive Yards for the Imperial Navy in 3 ABY. As the Penetrator was nearing completion, the young amateur slicer Shannon Voorson managed to slice into an Imperial computer file containing a list of Star Destroyers being built by Kuat Drive Yards, among which was the Penetrator. Shannon later showed the list to her cousin, Deen Voorson, a member of the Rebel Alliance.
